name: http-server
body: HTTP server: binds 127.0.0.1 only; default port 8080 with automatic fallback through 8081..8099 (20 ports total) when busy, then a startup error advising `--port` if all are busy; an explicit `--port` that is busy is a startup error (no fallback); reports the actual bound port for the printed link. Serves deck page or error page, embedded assets, deck assets/, the resolved library's `media/` (the URLs returned by the layout `media` helper) and each resolved-library `themes/<name>/` directory (theme.css and the theme-owned files it references by relative url()), content type by file extension, no path escapes; the /templates gallery and the live-reload endpoint, which pushes each deck-rebuilt notification to connected browsers. The reload pipeline pins the resolved library root to the configured `templates:` value captured at startup; a mid-session change to that value serves the full-page restart-required error (every served page) instead of retargeting, and the process keeps running (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
